parsed.side_detail: The right wall was only 0.25 m from me while the left wall was 1.50 m away, so I had far less room to give on my left; moving right kept me close to the right wall and left the wider part of the passage free for her and her cane. She was also coming toward me on my left, so stepping right opened the gap between us.

utterances.message: No problem, plenty of room — go ahead.
Thank you — I'm on my way to the hospital, coming through.
